recognize_zh: 兩顆大型反應性淋巴球，細胞質豐富淡藍，邊緣被相鄰紅血球擠壓成扇貝狀，且接觸紅血球處嗜鹼性加深（箭頭），核染色質細緻、無明顯核仁，這是傳染性單核球增多症典型的 Downey II 型反應性淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocytes with low-to-moderate N:C ratio and abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic borders scalloped around adjacent red cells with peripheral basophilia at points of contact (arrows)
Oval to irregular nuclei with relatively fine but mature chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Few small cytoplasmic vacuoles and a rare azurophilic granule
Heterogeneous appearance between the two cells (one paler, one more basophilic)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale to moderately basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasmic margins are scalloped by adjacent red cells and show condensation of basophilia at the points of contact (arrows). Nuclei are oval to irregular with fine but mature chromatin and no prominent nucleoli. No blasts are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with reactive (Downey type II) lymphocytes, as seen in infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Blasts have a high N:C ratio, fine immature chromatin with nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm, and they form a monotonous population rather than the heterogeneous cells here.
Monocytes have folded or lobulated nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles, without scalloping and peripheral basophilia around red cells.
LGLs have distinct azurophilic granules and do not show red-cell hugging peripheral basophilia.
Lymphoma cells are monomorphous with nuclear irregularity or clefting and are clonal by flow cytometry, while reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous and polyclonal.
